trials.claim: Generate short url using up to 10 custom domains
trials.claimQuote: Generate short url using up to 10 custom domains and a number of built-in domains
trials.reasoning: One buyer verified three custom domains, but other buyers report custom-domain validation and built-in domains failing, and no exhibit shows the claimed limit of 10 domains.

exhibits.quote: Did not work. Unable to validate the domain we added. Links do not work.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports custom-domain validation failed and links did not work, undermining the custom-domain claim.

exhibits.quote: There problems with the 2 inbuild shorten domains, they don't work at all in your browser.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports the built-in shortening domains do not work at all, undermining the built-in domains part.

exhibits.quote: Start free with 50 links and your own custom domain.
exhibits.argument: The vendor states the plan includes a custom domain for branded short links.

exhibits.quote: I got the Tier-2 and have added three of my own custom domains and verified them (clear simple instructions are given so even a non-techie should be able to follow it).
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms adding and verifying multiple custom domains for shortening works in practice.

trials.claim: Access to analytics data for past 12 months or up to 1,000,000 click events
trials.claimQuote: Access to analytics data for the past 12 months or up to 1,000,000 click events
trials.reasoning: The vendor listing shows 365-day analytics retention and 1M analytics events/mo, matching 12 months and 1,000,000 events; the 45-day limit cited is for a different free tier.

exhibits.quote:
- 45-day analytics retention

- Deep links, QR with logo, API & MCP access
exhibits.argument: Free tier is limited to 45-day retention, not 12 months of analytics history.
The 1M figure is a per-month events limit on Pro, not a total historical allowance.

exhibits.quote:
- Unlimited links & short links

- 10 custom domains

- 100 routing filters

- 365-day analytics retention

- 1M analytics events/mo
exhibits.argument: The vendor lists 365-day retention and 1M analytics events matching the 12-month and 1,000,000-event claim.

exhibits.quote: Linkila is fantastic, I finally found a solution to shorten my link and keep track with a simple and clear analyics.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms link shortening with simple and clear analytics tracking works.

trials.claim: WordPress integration adds short url redirection and analytics to existing WordPress sites
trials.claimQuote: WordPress Integration - add short url redirection and analytics to existing WordPress sites
trials.reasoning: Two buyers independently confirm the WordPress integration exists and is useful, with no exhibit contradicting it.

exhibits.quote: Excellent support team by the devs. Working out some kinks, but quality link tool. The wordpress integration is a godsend.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms the WordPress integration exists and is valuable.

exhibits.quote: It also integrates with WordPress and has extensions for Chrome and Firefox which is super-useful.
exhibits.argument: A second buyer confirms WordPress integration alongside browser extensions.

trials.claim: Add short URL redirection and/or page analytics to any web pages
trials.claimQuote: Add short URL redirection and/or page analytics to any web pages
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm redirects to specific pages, but another reports SSL and virus warnings on redirects, and no exhibit clearly shows adding redirection or page analytics to any web page.

exhibits.quote: short.im <- SSL Problem. 302.buzz <- Red varning in all browsers as a virus spam domain.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports SSL failure and browser virus warnings on redirects, undermining redirection to any page.

exhibits.quote: Added the txt record. Added my site instead of the built-in domains. Just checked my site today.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports adding the service to an existing site coincided with the site going down.

exhibits.quote: Track your marketing links, filter your traffic, redirect your traffic based on OS, Browser, Location and more.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms tracking and redirecting traffic based on visitor characteristics works.

exhibits.quote: One of the things that sets it apart is its unique redirect rules, which allow me to redirect my shortened URLs to specific pages or sections of my website.
exhibits.argument: A buyer confirms shortened URLs can redirect visitors to specific pages or sections.
